_contract: Each case: `say` is the sentence as talk would hear it, `tier` the tier that should handle it (0 none, 1 instant, 2 local, 3 cloud). Tier 1 cases name the expected menu key in `action` (`note:<stem>` for a note under Atlas). Tier 2 read cases carry `answer_has`, lowercase substrings the spoken reply must contain; tier 2 edit cases carry `diff_has`, lowercase substrings the added lines of the vault diff must contain, and `dept`, the one department note allowed to change. `ambiguous` marks a sentence where two tiers are defensible; the label is then the higher, safer one. Every expectation is true of demo-vault as it is on disk.
